Question Choices: Write an inequality: Temperature is warmer than 25°C. Use T to represent temperature
Hints: Decide which direction is required and whether equality is allowed.
Solution: “warmer than” means strictly greater than. Therefore T>25. The boundary itself is excluded.

Hints: Decide which direction is required and whether equality is allowed.
Solution: “at least” means greater than or equal to. Therefore W≥34. The boundary is included.

Question Choices: Select. Which listed feature belongs to the number-line graph of X > 50?: ~~Filled-dot-at-50 | Open-circle-at-50 | Shaded-left~~
Solution: > excludes 50, so use an open circle at 50. Shade right for greater values; a filled dot would wrongly include the boundary, and left shading has the wrong direction.

Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "Z < 18 includes 18": ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Solution: The strict inequality Z<18 excludes 18: substituting the boundary gives 18<18, which is false.

Question Choices: Select. Which listed feature belongs to the number-line graph of X ≤ 28?: ~~Filled-dot-at-28 | Open-circle-at-28 | Shaded-right~~
Solution: ≤ includes 28, so use an included, filled dot at 28. Shade left for smaller values; an open circle would wrongly exclude the boundary, and right shading has the wrong direction.

Hints: Keep values in the overlap, and check both endpoints.
